documents.text:
From: sana.q.blr@mailbox.example
To: claims@nimbusgeneral.example
Subject: Accident claim - KA05MN7788 - policy NMS-PC-231570

Hi team,

I am raising a claim for my i20 (KA05MN7788). On 2nd March evening, around 7:30, I was reversing out of a tight parking spot on 100 ft road Indiranagar (near the Sony signal side) and the back of the car scraped against a concrete pillar of the building. The rear bumper has a deep scrape and is cracked on the right side, and the right tail lamp glass is broken. Nothing happened to the pillar and no other vehicle was involved.

I have given the car to the Hyundai service centre and asked them for the estimate - they said it may take up to a week because of some system issue at their end. I will forward the estimate as soon as I receive it. Sending the claim form now itself so that the claim is registered in time.

Regards,
Sana Qureshi
